Among 2020-2024 papers containing "metabolized" , 44.5% of significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) – i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a higher than the typical neuroscience paper (median shown for reference). Relative to other words, "metabolized" papers are in the top 93rd percentile in terms of fragile p-value percentage (lower = better). Note, p-values highly predict replicability (see the associated paper).
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "metabolized" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (93rd percentile among all words) and tend to be cited more (52nd percentile word).
